hexsable.category.desc: Patterns from the Hex Sable Bridge add-on. They let hexes target Sable physics structures the same way they target entities. Each page opens with its own scroll.
hexsable.page.get: Takes a position (world or the structure's own block coordinates) and returns the physical structure there, or Null. Given an entity instead, returns the structure it is standing on or riding.
hexsable.page.zone: Returns every physical structure whose bounding box touches the sphere of the given radius around the position, nearest first (at most 64).
hexsable.page.pos: Pushes the world position of the structure's center of mass.
hexsable.page.velocity: Pushes the structure's linear velocity in blocks per tick, like an entity's velocity.
hexsable.page.angular_velocity: Pushes the structure's angular velocity in radians per tick (axis times speed, world frame).
hexsable.page.mass: Pushes the total mass of the structure (a normal block weighs 1).
hexsable.page.bounds: Pushes the minimum and then the maximum corner of the structure's world-space bounding box.
hexsable.page.to_world: Converts a position from the structure's own block coordinates to world coordinates.
hexsable.page.to_local: Converts a world position into the structure's own block coordinates. Ordinary block spells (Break Block, Place Block...) accept these coordinates.
hexsable.page.dir_to_world: Rotates a direction from the structure's frame into the world frame (no translation).
hexsable.page.dir_to_local: Rotates a world direction into the structure's frame (no translation).
hexsable.page.impulse: Changes the structure's velocity by the given vector (blocks per tick, world frame). Costs dust times mass times the squared vector length; repeated use on one structure in a single cast costs extra. Limited by the server config.
hexsable.page.impulse_at: Like Structure Impulse, but applies the push at the given world point, so an off-centre push also spins the structure. The cost includes the rotational energy.
hexsable.page.spin: Changes the structure's angular velocity by the given vector (radians per tick, world frame) around its center of mass.
hexsable.page.blink: Instantly moves the whole structure by the given offset, keeping its rotation and velocity. Costs about 2.5 dust per block times the square root of the mass. Careful: do not blink into terrain.
hexsable.message.scroll_locked: The page with this pattern is still closed — find its scroll first
